probe_source:
import json
from services.control_plane.bff.ports.read_surface_ports import ReadSurfacePorts
from services.control_plane.bff.ports.research_knowledge_source import DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort
from services.control_plane.bff.command_adapters.evolution_adapter import EvolutionCommandAdapter
from services.control_plane.bff.command_adapters.registry import find_adapter

observations = {}
port = ReadSurfacePorts()
observations["ticket_masquerades_as_job"] = (
    hasattr(port, "get_job_bff") and hasattr(port, "list_jobs_bff")
)

rks = DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort()
exp = rks.create_research_experiment(
    ticket_id="ticket-001",
    experiment_name="test-exp",
    strategy_selector={},
    parameter_set={},
    run_config={"dataset_ref": "d1", "time_range": {"start_at": "a", "end_at": "b"}, "execution_mode": "paper", "priority": "normal", "requested_by": "user"},
    launch_context={},
)
observations["in_memory_experiments_writer"] = (
    exp["experiment_id"] in rks._experiments
    and rks._experiments[exp["experiment_id"]]["status"] == "queued"
)

evo = EvolutionCommandAdapter()
assert evo.can_handle("JobAction", "job", "cancel")
receipt = evo.execute("cmd-1", "JobAction", {"job_id": "job-1", "action_id": "cancel"})
observations["evolution_adapter_fake_job_action_executed"] = (
    receipt["status"] == "executed"
    and receipt["domain_receipt"].get("success") is True
    and receipt["dispatch_path"] == "research_job_authority"
)

adapter = find_adapter("JobAction", "job", "cancel")
observations["registry_routes_job_to_evolution_adapter"] = isinstance(adapter, EvolutionCommandAdapter)

with open("services/control-plane/bff/events/router.py") as f:
    events_code = f.read()
observations["sse_job_progress_ignores_job_id"] = "Subscription is channel-based; job filtering remains client-side" in events_code

assert all(observations.values()), observations
print(json.dumps({"observations": observations, "count": len(observations),
                  "interpretation": "five current deficiencies reproduced; not implementation acceptance"}, sort_keys=True))
